metarCollisionGeometry: stable all-bearing wind reservation at 90% radius; slight barb-to-number contact allowed; numeric labels kept separate
metarWindReservation: normal complete barb even in calm/VRB; expands for longer reported wind symbols
rapmetTemperatureBasis: direct HF-ASOS Kelvin decoded to Celsius; whole-C display
rapmetReports: HF-ASOS only at five-minute timestamps; no routine METAR or SPECI
rapmetSource: NOAA MADIS direct, raw IEM HF fallback only
observationAverage: latest common five-minute time, equal Celsius mean, Fahrenheit conversion then whole-degree rounding
observationWind: scalar mph mean rounded once; speed-weighted vector and eight compass points
observationPreparedSource: shared RAPMET object, no additional upstream request or job
